What we do

One programme, three commitments.

Community Outreach

Nutrition camps and home-level guidance for families affected by sickle cell anaemia and malnutrition.

Mental Health

Compassionate, stigma-free support for patients, caregivers and the health workers who serve them.

Nursing Education

Training the next generation of nurses in community nutrition and care across India.

About us

Food as the first medicine.

CNF, the Community Nutrition Formula, is a community-led initiative working on sickle cell anaemia and malnutrition. We design simple, affordable nutrition guidance and take it directly into communities.

Our work is run under the Community Outreach, Mental Health and Nursing Education Programme of India, bringing together field outreach, emotional well-being support and the training of nurses who sustain care for years to come.

Everyone is welcome to join, learn, and contribute their stories.
